query: Oh my goodness, the neighbor's cat snuck onto my balcony this morning and knocked over the potted mint I've been growing for months, I spent almost an hour cleaning up the soil and making sure the roots were still okay, I really hope it recovers soon. I also just found the most amazing recipe for lemon mint iced tea online yesterday, I was so excited to use my homegrown mint for it, now I'm not sure if I'll have enough.
